title: Keep billing authority in product rules, not the model
narrative: A customer was charged twice. Only the billing team may own the ticket. The model may suggest a team, but product policy allows only when the route signal is billing — and a high quality score alone must not override missing completion evidence. See also `fangore_decision_surface_reject`.
implementation:
Provider-neutral judge types (`Choice`/`Score`/`Noul` questions and signals) plus `JudgementPolicy` / `decide()` apply configured thresholds. `CliInstrumentor` verb `judge_route` runs judge+decide. System One maps vendor wire via `SystemOneJudgeProvider`.

Covers: POL-02, JDG-01, JDG-02, JDG-04, VER-02.
validation: Harness `cli` scenario `billing_allow.yaml`: hard `route_selected`/`verdict`/`answer_count`. Twins: static fixture + systemone cassette. Unit: `tests/test_judgement_policy.py`, `tests/test_judge.py`.
